layout.title: How an Escalator Works

shows.does: a moving belt runs up the slope between the basement and the floor
a tennis ball set on the steep belt rolls back down to the bottom
flat steps pop onto the belt, tilted with the slope
a box set on a tilted step slides off and crashes at the bottom
red and blue tracks appear and every step swings level
a glowing outline traces the escalator
the belt stops running and the level steps hold still, the ball waiting at the bottom
the gear at the top turns and the level steps move up the slope
the gear stops and the steps roll back down
a red brake appears beside the gear
the brake slams into the gear and the steps jolt with a crash
a handrail appears along the steps
the gear turns, the steps move up and the tennis ball rides them to the top floor
the finished escalator, the ball at the top

layout.why: An escalator built in a room cut open down to the basement: a bare belt up the slope, steps, wheels in two tracks that keep them level, a motor gear that pulls them, a brake and a handrail, following what rides it from the bottom landing up to the top floor. A tennis ball rolls back down the bare belt early on and rides the finished steps to the top at the end. The camera stays side-on to the whole slope, with a close look at the gear and brake.

sentences.text: If you run a belt up a slope, you have an escalator.
But a ball on the belt rolls back down.
So you bolt flat steps on the belt.
But the steps tilt, and the box slides off.
So wheels in two tracks hold each step level.
But the level steps hold still; nothing pulls them.
So you add a motor that turns a gear.
But if the motor fails, the steps roll back.
So you add a brake beside the gear.
But the brake grabs, and the steps jolt.
So you add a moving handrail to hold.
Set the ball on a step, and it rides up.

recurring.what: a tennis ball that rolls back down the bare belt and rides the finished steps to the top

chain.shows: a ball on the steep belt rolls back to the bottom
chain.stakes: nothing stays on, so nothing gets upstairs

chain.shows: the steps tilt and the box slides off
chain.stakes: anything standing on a step tips over

chain.shows: the gear stops and the steps roll back down
chain.stakes: a crowd of riders slides back

chain.shows: the brake slams in and the steps jolt

ideas.idea: a belt running up a slope between two floors is an escalator
on the steep belt things roll back down
flat steps on the belt give things something to stand on
the steps tilt with the slope, so things slide off them
each step runs on wheels in two tracks that hold it level
the loop of linked steps is a step chain
level steps on tracks just sit there: nothing pulls them
a motor at the top turns a gear that pulls the step chain up
if the motor fails, the loaded steps roll back down
a brake at the gear stops the steps when the power fails
when the brake grabs, the steps jolt
a moving handrail gives riders something to hold
the ball rides the finished steps to the top
